// REQ: LANG-2971 LANG-2972 LANG-2973 LANG-2974
// Greeter object
integer count = 0;
default
{
    state_entry()
    {
        llSetText("Touch me", <1.0, 1.0, 1.0>, 1.0);
    }
    touch_start(integer total)
    {
        count++;
        llSay(0, "Hello, " + llDetectedName(0) + "! " + (string)count);
    }
}
